This PR does 2 main things.
1. Response from snowflake has changed after implementation, all the response have a "status" key which was causing inputs to go empty. It has been fixed by removing check on status key.
2. We were returning deduplicated inputs at directory level instead at file level. As the naming convention doc says we need to have the object key in input name, I have fixed the implementation.

Closes: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/47019

issue_context.title: Snowflake CopyFromExternalStageToSnowflake OpenLineage support not working
issue_context.body:
### Apache Airflow Provider(s)

snowflake

### Versions of Apache Airflow Providers

apache_airflow_providers_snowflake-6.0.0

### Apache Airflow version

2.9.3

### Operating System

Mac OS Sequioa 15.3 (24D60)

### Deployment

Official Apache Airflow Helm Chart

### Deployment details

I am using breeze, standard deployment 
```
 breeze start-airflow --integration openlineage -b postgres --use-airflow-version 2.9.3
```

### What happened

We are not getting inputs in OpenLineage COMPLETE event.
This is due to a check on `status` key in the result row from snowflake.
and we have a check on existance of `status` key, which is passing empty list in the parsing function.

### What you think should happen instead

Ideally we should be getting correct inputs in the openlineage COMPLETE event according to the implementation.

The function should check the status value before passing an empty list to the parsing function.

### How to reproduce

Use CopyFromExternalStageToSnowflake Operator in Airflow with OpenLineage events enabled, you will not get any inputs in the OL COMPLETE event.

### Anything else

_No response_

### Are you willing to submit PR?

- [x] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
comments: Hey Rahul, thanks for the issue. As we discussed on Slack [here](https://openlineage.slack.com/archives/C01CK9T7HKR/p1739826600770119), there might be some adjustments needed if the result from Snowflake has changed + some test to cover that. Let me know when you have some time to dig into that and prepare a PR, will be happy to review.

review_comments: Could you add some test cases with errors, to make sure it will not break other datasets?

@kacpermuda do you remember in which cases we were getting
```
[{"status": "0 files were uploaded..."}]
```
I could not find a test for this condition.
They have defined the status response [here](https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/sql/copy-into-table#output) now

@rahul-madaan  I think it was the case when trying to upload files from some empty directory. Can you check what response will you get in such scenario? Maybe it's simply empty now, so there is no need to treat it differently, but it would be good to include that in test cases.
Done! I have added a condition to check when there is no file movement.
